name: Readeck
tagline: Self-hosted bookmark manager and read-it-later app
description: Readeck is a simple web application that lets you save the precious readable content of web pages you like and want to keep forever. It is a self-hosted alternative to Instapaper and Wallabag with a modern interface and powerful features for managing your bookmarks and reading list.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-readeck application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-readeck
  # The main Readeck service definition
  big-bear-readeck:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-readeck
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: codeberg.org/readeck/readeck:0.22.3@sha256:ed1c513f8e1d59b1d38fda324ac279eeb65afd0327907e498061ec9fd2f31c15
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for Readeck configuration
    environment:
      # Defines the application log level. Can be error, warn, info, debug.
      - READECK_LOG_LEVEL=info
      # The IP address on which Readeck listens
      - READECK_SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0
      # The TCP port on which Readeck listens
      - READECK_SERVER_PORT=8000
      # Log format (json, text, or dev)
      - READECK_LOG_FORMAT=text
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Volume mapping for persistent data storage
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/readeck
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8000 of the host to port 8000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
    # Health check configuration
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/bin/readeck", "healthcheck", "-config", "config.toml"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 3
